reason: I work full time, so it's Saturdays only and maybe the odd day off. We'd go once or twice a month, and that doesn't justify a $59 membership. Drop-in at $12 plus $8 for the sibling is fine, but the baby is under 1 and free, so I'd only pay for my 4-year-old.
objection: I can only go on weekends, so a monthly membership is money for days I won't use. Saturday is also when it's probably busiest and the calm village stops being calm.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper tier for weekend-only or a few visits a month (a 4-visit pack around $30), or a free trial Saturday to see how crowded it gets.
